edits.old: Then the grant refuses it and the build fails
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses it and the build fails

  Scenario: AC10 An activity that is retried or times out changes nothing twice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of the pass is retried or does not answer inside its timeout
    When the activity runs again
    Then the record, the validity and the command are each written once per firm per pass

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call of the pass fails or does not answer
    When the pass runs
    Then the users keep their validity and no command is sent

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a status change that the status model does not allow
    When the pass attempts the change
    Then the system refuses it and the status stays as it was

  Scenario: AC13 The pass publishes no event (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the contract of a firm ends today
    When the pass runs
    Then no event is published and no message announces a recall

  Scenario: AC14 A partner user row holds no personal data (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a partner user with a sign-in mapped to its row
    When the pass runs and the portal reads the account
    Then no name, e-mail, phone number or identity number is written to a row, a log or a workflow input

  Scenario: AC15 A value the business may change is read with its version, not written in code (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the panel states, the instruction states, the types, the contract end and the right
    When the pass reads them
    Then each is read with its version and none is set in code
